name: Revenga de Campos (Spain)
description: Green field with a broad red band edged white from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the upper hoist with a white scallop shell.
history: Municipal flag of Revenga de Campos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band edged white from the lower hoist to the upper fly
scallop shell at the upper hoist
